task: external backtest baselines: Taal vs seasonal-naive vs trailing 28-day mean, same slots, same scoring

inputs.dataset: UCI Online Retail II (CC BY 4.0), top 300 SKUs by units, node = country, one cluster

protocol.train_test_boundary: for each origin O: fit/lookup uses only days strictly before O; the test days are O .. O+6
protocol.scored_slot: (series, origin, horizon day) with actual units > 0; no-sale days are not scored, as in run_backtest

metrics.wape: sum|forecast - actual| / sum(actual) over all scored series-days, pooled
metrics.mean_mape: run_backtest convention: mean of per-origin mean absolute percentage error (one tier)

protocol.exclusion_rule: a (series, origin) is dropped for all methods when the series' first sale is less than 28 days before the origin

methods.taal: jobs.sense.forecast.SeriesModel.p50, refit on days < origin (as run_backtest), no promo/festival flag
methods.seasonal_naive: units on the same weekday one week before the forecast day (d - 7, always < origin for a 7-day horizon); no row = 0
methods.trailing_28d_mean: mean units per calendar day over the 28 days before the origin, no-sale days counted as 0; one flat value for all 7 horizon days
methods.trailing_28d_mean_sale_days_only: sensitivity only, not a headline baseline: same window, mean over days that had a sale (SeriesModel's own level convention)
